subject: general
question: John, Johnny and Janardan can finish a task in a field in 6, 12 and 24 days, respectively. In how many days will they finish the task working together?
solution:
Given:

John can do the work in 6 days

Johnny can do the work in 12 days

Janardan can do the work in 24 days

Formula used:

Work done = Time taken × Efficiency

Time taken ∝ (1)/(Efficiency)

Calculation:

The efficiency of John is 1/6

The efficiency of Johnny is 1/12

The efficiency of Janardan is 1/24

One day work of John, Johnny and Janardan together

Efficiency = (1)/(6) + (1)/(12) +frac {1}{24}

= ((4 + 2 + 1))/(24) = (7)/(24)

Time taken = (1)/(Efficiency) = (1)/(frac{7){24}} = (24)/(7)

Therefore, Work completed in (24)/(7) days

= 3(3)/(7)days

∴ In** 3(3)/(7)** days the work will be completed.
